final_recommendation: The room converged on a sequenced rescue framework: SNB commits CHF 100 billion unconditional liquidity live Monday; Federal Council announces framework intent tonight but signs decree only Sunday after UBS initials loss-floor terms; emergency asset triage tonight surfaces balance-sheet deterioration before any signatures; loss-absorption waterfall written into decree to protect creditor hierarchy.
minority_objections: UBS CEO rejected CHF 10B loss floor as insufficient without full asset-level detail and unconditional liquidity in writing
AT1 rep demanded written creditor hierarchy protection before any triage or term sheet
Wealth client objected that announcing liquidity without locked buyer creates false confidence and renegotiation risk Sunday
key_conflicts: Federal Council vs SNB: Council refused to sign decree before UBS commits; SNB demanded decree ready by Sunday 18:00 to make liquidity conditional
UBS vs FINMA: UBS demanded CHF 16B+ loss floor with full asset detail and unconditional liquidity before signing; FINMA pushed for binding term sheet tonight on CHF 10B
AT1 rep vs all parties: insisted equity must absorb losses before AT1, AT1 before senior debt, threatening legal challenge if hierarchy violated
key_concessions: SNB agreed to CHF 100B liquidity live Monday but capped exposure if asset deterioration exceeds CHF 16B
Federal Council agreed to announce framework intent tonight but deferred decree signature until Sunday after UBS initials
FINMA agreed to emergency asset triage tonight with full balance-sheet access to surface deterioration before signatures
All parties agreed loss-absorption waterfall must be written into decree language before triage begins
red_lines: UBS: will not sign without unconditional SNB liquidity in writing and full loss-floor detail by asset tranche
Federal Council: will not sign decree without UBS binding commitment first (no blank check)
SNB: liquidity ceiling drops if asset deterioration widens loss floor beyond CHF 16B
AT1 rep: equity must absorb losses before AT1 or legal challenge follows
CS CEO: must have named buyer and done deal by Sunday morning or move to resolution messaging
ignored_or_underweighted_risks: Risk that asset triage tonight surfaces deterioration forcing Sunday renegotiation despite announced framework
Risk that UBS walks away Sunday morning after triage results, leaving decree politically exposed
Risk that announcing CHF 100B liquidity tonight without locked buyer creates moral hazard and false market confidence
Risk that emergency decree without Parliamentary pre-approval faces legal challenge Monday
Risk that creditor hierarchy protection in decree language is unenforceable if resolution mechanics require deviation
downstream_risk_variables: Asset triage outcome tonight: if deterioration exceeds CHF 16B, entire framework reopens
UBS decision by midnight tonight: if no initialed term sheet, pivot to resolution messaging required
Parliamentary reaction to emergency decree: legal defensibility depends on narrow scope and time limit
Market interpretation of announced liquidity without named buyer: could trigger further flight if read as hedged
Creditor legal challenges: AT1 and senior debt holders primed to sue if hierarchy violated in execution
uncertainty_notes: The room achieved procedural consensus on sequencing (announce tonight, triage tonight, sign Sunday) but left three critical uncertainties unresolved: (1) whether asset triage will stay within CHF 16B loss floor or force renegotiation; (2) whether UBS will actually initial terms tonight given their stated objections; (3) whether the loss-absorption waterfall can be legally enforced in practice if resolution mechanics require deviation. The framework is conditional on all three resolving favorably by Sunday evening.

marker_evidence.ubs_rescue_path: Entire framework structured around UBS signing term sheet tonight with CHF 10-16B loss floor; decree signature conditional on UBS commitment; asset triage designed to lock UBS terms before Sunday
marker_evidence.government_support: CHF 10-16B loss floor in Federal Council decree became binding constraint on UBS decision; SNB CHF 100B liquidity backstop and decree authority drove the entire rescue structure
marker_evidence.client_flight: Wealth client threatened Monday withdrawal and demanded named buyer; CS CEO cited client need for 'done deal'; but did not drive specific numbers or concessions in the framework
marker_evidence.at1_tail_risk: AT1 rep's demand for written loss-absorption waterfall (equity before AT1 before senior) became red line; forced FINMA/UBS to commit hierarchy in decree language before triage; shaped legal structure
